issue_context.title: avoid impossible values are added into estimated row count
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Ref: #32758

Currently, in our cardinality estimation logic, the impossible values like `MaxValue` and `MinNotNull` are possible to be added into row count. This will lead to high estimation errors sometimes and needs to be avoided.

review_comments: I added indentation to make it easier to read. 😂
Emm it seems a little confusing, so please add some comment to explain in what case the condition `lowVal.Kind() != types.KindMaxValue && lowVal.Kind() != types.KindMinNotNull` can be true.
